hero.status: Available for a work-study position starting in November 2026

about.title: About me
about.p1: I arrived at École 42 without knowing what to expect and discovered software development through hands-on practice—ranging from low-level C programming to full-scale web applications. After exploring both front-end and back-end development, I found my niche in full-stack work. What I love is creating tools that are genuinely useful to their users and finally seeing everything work after a long debugging session.
about.p2: I have completed the core curriculum and am working towards the RNCP Level 7 qualification at 42. I am looking for a work-study position (or an internship) starting in November 2026, to join a team where I can contribute and learn new technologies.
about.p3: Before 42, I completed a work-study program—so I’m well-acquainted with the balance between working and training.
